outcome: Rates of Cesarean delivery for labor dystocia
cohort: 403,205 nulliparous women delivering term singletons in cephalic position following labor
finding: Considerable inter-hospital variation in rates of Cesarean delivery for labor dystocia remained after accounting for differences in maternal and hospital factors.
mod_finding: The study found considerable inter-hospital variation in rates of Caesarean delivery for labor dystocia, even after accounting for differences in maternal and hospital factors.
